title: test: invalidate the memo when mutating record files out-of-band
context:
The issue-29 regression test deletes and writes record files directly,
behind the store. loadAll memoizes per kind keyed by the kind directory
mtime, and the test completes in ~40ms — inside a single filesystem
timestamp tick — so the cache kept serving a just-deleted record and the
raw-vs-loaded counts falsely agreed, skipping the expected refusal. It
passed solo (different timestamp landing) and failed under the full
suite. Explicit clearCache after each direct mutation, the same call the
long
